normalization: Only remove commas immediately preceding a JSON object or array close in a private in-memory parse buffer. Hash and preserve the original raw report bytes unchanged.
all_cells_rule: Output table names, order, column metadata, row counts, row widths, and 4044 typed cells must equal the pinned child projection produced from the parent projection. This is a complete predicate for every cell and metadata element.

projection_rules.ProblemDescription: Set only PDESC[0,0] to the exact frozen child description in contract.json.
projection_rules.ResultSummary: All 11 typed cells equal the accepted parent projection.
projection_rules.StockTotalResults: All 72x16 typed cells equal the accepted parent projection.
projection_rules.SystemResults: Retain the original six state-row projections and target STINT/ETINT JSON tokens. Then derive SYDT/NSYDT independently for all 72 bins from the frozen closed downtime periods and the primary manual pages645-646. A concluded period is counted only in its start bin; no starts means NSYDT integer0/SYDT null. Other fields and full typed topology remain asserted.

system_row_projection.reason: first direct CM remains in repair after the parent completion time
first direct CM remains in repair until child completion
first direct CM completes at 11.5; transfer the parent post-completion state and NREPT=1
second direct CM remains in repair after the parent completion time
second direct CM remains in repair until child completion
second direct CM completes at 35.5; transfer the parent post-completion state and NREPT=1

reconciliation.failure_count: sum(SystemResults.NFAIL) == 2 and equals the two exact failure events in the closed child model.log.
reconciliation.repair_completion_count: sum(SystemResults.NREPT) == 2 and equals the two exact child completion lines.
reconciliation.completed_repair_aircraft_hours: sum(SystemResults.NSYRP * (ETINT-STINT)) == 3.0 exactly within 1e-6 h; the two child repair intervals are [10,11.5) and [34,35.5).
reconciliation.terminal_state: last SystemResults row has NSYRY=1 and NSYRP=0.
reconciliation.stock: all stock cells equal the parent projection; summed NBO, NDD, NDR, NDP, and NLD remain 0; no inventory effect is asserted.
reconciliation.summary: all 11 ResultSummary cells equal the parent projection; MSUF remains 0.3333333432674408.
reconciliation.downtime: sum(NSYDT)==2; sum(SYDT*NSYDT for non-null rows)==3.0; equals the two full closed [10,11.5),[34,35.5) intervals, independently of occupancy-bin integration.

typed_json_comparison: Every JSON node must retain exact Python JSON type identity recursively; int, float, and bool are distinct, including inside table metadata. In addition, each row width and the declared string/double schema are checked. No Python loose equality is permitted.
negative_controls: A parent SystemResults.NSYRY integer 1 changed to float 1.0 is rejected.
A parent StockTotalResults.NBO integer 0 changed to boolean false is rejected.
A table column key boolean true changed to integer 1 is rejected.
A child NREPT completion count or post-repair state cell changed from its projected value is rejected.
Wrong start-bin SYDT duration is rejected.
Fake additional downtime in an occupancy continuation bin is rejected.
Wrong continuation-bin non-null SYDT is rejected.
Wrong second-period NSYDT count is rejected.
Wrong unrelated StockTotalResults cell is rejected.

system_downtime_projection.registration: concluded downtime is recorded in interval containing its start; NSYDT counts periods and SYDT is their full mean duration; bins with no starts have NSYDT=0 and SYDT=null
system_downtime_projection.derivation: Starts and completions are the frozen expected child events, not copied report cells. Both periods conclude before the unchanged hour36 horizon.
